gazelle: dart: disagreeing/lib: the options of `json_serializable:json_serializable` are stated twice, differently: {"field_rename": "kebab"} by `# gazelle:dart_builder_config JsonSerializable`, {"field_rename":"snake"} by disagreeing/build.yaml; state them once, or make the two agree
gazelle: dart: refused/build.release.yaml: build_runner reads it only when run with `--config release`, and a Bazel build has one set of builder options. Gazelle carries into the build only `targets.$default.builders.<builder>.options`, as that builder's `config`; a codegen macro's `srcs` choose the files it runs on. State the rest in BUILD files, or add `# gazelle:exclude build.release.yaml` to the package's BUILD file so that Gazelle does not read it

State the rest in BUILD files, or add `# gazelle:exclude build.yaml` to the package's BUILD file so that Gazelle does not read it
